name: Ekon
source:
Ekon is a white collar worker operating in one of the city's many offices. One day, when he was returning from work, he noticed a lonely light in a distant forest. Ekon followed the light, not knowing that his world view and his life would radically change.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/3-1-0-2190]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
埃孔是一名白领，在城里众多办公室中的一间上班。某天下班回家时，他注意到远处森林里有一点孤零零的光。埃孔循着光走去，却不知道，自己的世界观与人生都即将发生翻天覆地的变化。

[译编自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/3-1-0-2190]Anivisual[/url]]
